```artifact
Feature: Prescription Management

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Request Generates One Prescription
    Given a patient consultation request exists
    When the request is processed
    Then one prescription is generated
    And the prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Prescription is Mapped to One and Only One Patient Consultation Request
    Given a prescription exists
    When the prescription is mapped to a patient consultation request
    Then the prescription is mapped to one and only one patient consultation request

  Scenario: Chemist Receives One or More Prescriptions
    Given a chemist exists
    When one or more prescriptions are sent to the chemist
    Then the chemist receives the prescriptions

  Scenario: Prescription is Mapped to One and Only One Chemist
    Given a prescription exists
    When the prescription is mapped to a chemist
    Then the prescription is mapped to one and only one chemist
    And the mapping is unique

  Scenario: Lab Receives One or More Prescriptions
    Given a lab exists
    When one or more prescriptions are sent to the lab
    Then the lab receives the prescriptions

  Scenario: Prescription is Mapped to One and Only One Lab
    Given a prescription exists
    When the prescription is mapped to a lab
    Then the prescription is mapped to one and only one lab
    And the mapping is unique

  Scenario Outline: Multiple Prescriptions for One Patient Consultation Request
    Given a patient consultation request exists
    And <num_prescriptions> prescriptions are generated
    When the prescriptions are processed
    Then the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Examples:
      | num_prescriptions |
      | 1                 |
      | 2                 |
      | 3                 |

  Scenario Outline: Multiple Prescriptions for One Chemist
    Given a chemist exists
    And <num_prescriptions> prescriptions are sent to the chemist
    When the prescriptions are processed
    Then the prescriptions are received by the chemist
    Examples:
      | num_prescriptions |
      | 1                 |
      | 2                 |
      | 3                 |

  Scenario Outline: Multiple Prescriptions for One Lab
    Given a lab exists
    And <num_prescriptions> prescriptions are sent to the lab
    When the prescriptions are processed
    Then the prescriptions are received by the lab
    Examples:
      | num_prescriptions |
      | 1                 |
      | 2                 |
      | 3                 |

  Scenario: Mapping Error - Prescription Mapped to Multiple Requests
    Given a prescription exists
    And the prescription is mapped to multiple patient consultation requests
    When the mapping is processed
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Mapping Error - Prescription Mapped to Multiple Chemists
    Given a prescription exists
    And the prescription is mapped to multiple chemists
    When the mapping is processed
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Mapping Error - Prescription Mapped to Multiple Labs
    Given a prescription exists
    And the prescription is mapped to multiple labs
    When the mapping is processed
    Then an error is raised
```
